'''Magnatrams''' were a form of mass transit. They were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Risban]] with [[Fortress Keremark]] to ferry people and supplies up a steep cliff to a landing field.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
